Question: As salamu alaikum Wo rahmatullahi Wo barakatuhu, I am working as a software engineer. can you please tell me the etiquettes i need to follow at work as per islam as "Sahaba use to understand the deen of business before they start. Answer ID: 10262 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 63/63=D/429) Get the below books from book deports of Deoband or Delhi and study them, in-shaAllah you shall get benefit of the world and the hereafter. Then, if any thing remains questionable write to us. The books are: (1) Adaab Al-Muasharat by Hadhrat Thanwi (2) Safayi-e-Muamalat by Hadhrat Thanwi (3) Uswah-e-Rasool Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Walsallam, by Hadhrat Dr Abdul Hayee. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
